name: dsh-power-switch
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin (Windows only): a one-click shutdown button in the sidebar that leaves through DSH's own graceful exit, plus an app-window / normal-tab switch on the Settings -> Plugins card that saves the mode, fixes the desktop shortcut and restarts DSH — replaying the command the running host recorded for itself, and refusing the restart rather than risking an outage. 在侧边栏一键关闭 DSH 进程（走官方优雅退出通道），并在设置 → 插件页切换「应用窗口 / 普通标签页」：保存设置 → 改好桌面快捷方式 → 重启 DSH（重放宿主自己记录的真实启动命令；无法安全重启时明确拒绝，不会把服务丢下）。
author: SanYe-SanJiu

dshhub.summary: Windows 版：侧边栏一键关闭 DSH 进程（经官方优雅退出通道），并在设置 → 插件页切换「应用窗口 / 普通标签页」——自动改好桌面快捷方式、重放宿主记录的启动命令并重启；无法安全重启时明确拒绝并保持服务可用。One-click DSH shutdown from the sidebar, plus an app-window / tab launch switch on the Plugins page that also fixes the desktop shortcut (Windows only).
